hooks.command: case "$OSTYPE" in darwin*) case $((RANDOM % 6)) in 0) C='{8000, 14000, 22000}' ;; 1) C='{6000, 16000, 18000}' ;; 2) C='{8000, 18000, 11000}' ;; 3) C='{16000, 10000, 22000}' ;; 4) C='{22000, 9000, 12000}' ;; 5) C='{22000, 15000, 7000}' ;; esac; osascript -e "tell application \"Terminal\" to set background color of selected tab of front window to $C" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac

case "$OSTYPE" in darwin*) afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Pop.aiff >/dev/null 2>&1 & ;; msys*|cygwin*) powershell.exe -c "[console]::beep(880,80)" >/dev/null 2>&1 & ;; esac; echo '{"systemMessage":"✳ Claude Code"}'
